release_rules: No Critical or High risk is accepted by this candidate.
No skipped, timed-out, simulated-host, or environment-blocked native security test counts as PASS.
Linux and Windows must qualify together on the same candidate SHA.
Existing Phase 1 and Linux-only evidence cannot qualify the trusted verifier.
Default-on is a separate future owner decision.
